notes.title: Update Note Mar 6, 2019
notes.content:
[b]What we did:[/b]

1. Game performance optimized.

2. Some bugs fixed. These bugs may cause game crash or inconsistency during gameplay.

3. Updated some code to get prepared for upcoming free DLC and map editor function.

notes.title: Update Note Jan 30, 2019
notes.content:
[b]What we did:[/b]

1. Added button R function in tutorial levels so that players can try their own moves. But following the steps of tutrial is strongly recommended.

2. Some bugs fixed.

3. Functional texts improved. For example, after you finished the true ending, you just need to restart the last level without collecting all gems, then the normal ending will be unlocked.

[b]What we will do:
[/b]
1. Add more challenging levels in forms of free DLCs.
2. Let players create thier own levels and share with other players
